qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global market leader in rolling bearings and condition monitoring with extensive industrial distribution networks and OEM engineering integration. Sustains ~14-15% ROCE in core industrial operations.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 5, REJECT). While SKF holds a global leading market share in rolling bearings with an established industrial distributor network, rolling bearings are increasingly standardized and face intense structural price pressure from low-cost Asian manufacturers. Furthermore, vehicle electrification reduces rotating bearing counts by 30-40%, capping its competitive advantage period well below the 15-year hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: FY2024 sales MSEK 98,722 with 10.5% reported operating margin; FY2025 sales MSEK 91,583 with 8.5% reported margin and net profit dropping to MSEK 4,249. Automotive separation (SKF Vertevo) highlights poor structural automotive returns (2.6-4.5% margins). Net debt MSEK 12,052. Standardized product profile and commoditization risks limit compounding runway.
